children: ) announced Wednesday that Dennis Blasutti will resume his duties as chief financial officer, effective October 1, 2026.

The Trust highlighted that Franca Smith has concluded her appointment as interim chief financial officer and will continue in her role as senior vice president, Finance. Smith served as interim chief financial officer from March 23, 2026, through September 2026, providing leadership of the finance function.
